result.reason: The addition appropriately provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return, and deletion certification while preserving the existing post-termination rights. However, the 30-day export deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than from expiration or termination, so Commerce One has no automatic obligation to return the data within 30 days of the termination event as required by both the preferred and fallback positions. The drafting is otherwise focused and professional.
